typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CTRCCY as string,
		CCYREVALRATE as double,
		CTRNPVRATE_10 as integer,
		CTRDISCNPVRATE_10 as integer,
		CCYSPOTDATE as timestamp,
		BIDOFFERIND as string,
		CTRSPOTRATE as double,
		PRODCODE as string,
		CTRREVALRATE as double,
		CCYDISCNPVRATE_10 as integer,
		BR as string,
		CTRSPOTDATE as timestamp,
		CTRDISCNPVFACTOR_10 as integer,
		CCYNPVFACTOR_10 as integer,
		CTRNPVFACTOR_10 as integer,
		CCY as string,
		CCYSPOTRATE as double,
		PAIRSPOTDATE as timestamp,
		CCYNPVRATE_10 as integer,
		VDATE as timestamp,
		CCYDISCNPVFACTOR_10 as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CTRCCY as string,
		CCYREVALRATE as double,
		CTRNPVRATE_10 as double,
		CTRDISCNPVRATE_10 as double,
		CCYSPOTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BIDOFFERIND as string,
		CTRSPOTRATE as double,
		PRODCODE as string,
		CTRREVALRATE as double,
		CCYDISCNPVRATE_10 as double,
		BR as string,
		CTRSPOTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CTRDISCNPVFACTOR_10 as double,
		CCYNPVFACTOR_10 as double,
		CTRNPVFACTOR_10 as double,
		CCY as string,
		CCYSPOTRATE as double,
		PAIRSPOTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CCYNPVRATE_10 as double,
		VDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CCYDISCNPVFACTOR_10 as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PRODTYPE,
		CTRCCY,
		CCYREVALRATE,
		CTRNPVRATE_10,
		CTRDISCNPVRATE_10,
		CCYSPOTDATE,
		BIDOFFERIND,
		CTRSPOTRATE,
		PRODCODE,
		CTRREVALRATE,
		CCYDISCNPVRATE_10,
		BR,
		CTRSPOTDATE,
		CTRDISCNPVFACTOR_10,
		CCYNPVFACTOR_10,
		CTRNPVFACTOR_10,
		CCY,
		CCYSPOTRATE,
		PAIRSPOTDATE,
		CCYNPVRATE_10,
		VDATE,
		CCYDISCNPVFACTOR_10),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
